property_summary: After calling Collect with an amount exactly equal to balances[caller] (which triggers a call to receive() sending 0 value, which in reference calls Deposit and passes require(balances[msg.sender] + msg.value >= balances[msg.sender]) but in buggy version reverts on require(false)), the reference successfully completes the Collect and updates Log, while buggy version reverts.
change_summary: Replace the require statement with require(false) to always revert.
